run_compute_nllb_alti: run compute_nllb_alti to calculate ALTI metrics for French to English translation pairs using an NLLB model
run_main_with_hydra: run the Hydra-configured main function to compute ALTI metrics from a TSV input file with source and target columns
review_ALTIMetricsConfig: review the ALTIMetricsConfig dataclass to understand required fields like checkpoint, data_dir, spm, and language settings
review_compute_nllb_alti: review the compute_nllb_alti function that loads a model, computes ALTI scores, and writes metrics and alignments to files
run_nllb_alti_demo: run the NLLB ALTI demo preset to compute alignment metrics on a TSV of source and machine-translated text pairs
